hero.title: Evaluate NQ target research with the original record in view.
hero.description: Harper Vance publishes qualifying intraday NQ price targets with direction, timestamps, and session context. Review what was published and what happened afterward, then decide whether the research fits your desk's workflow.

record.label: Representative record format
record.footnote: Example format. Not a live or historical result.

included.title: A price target, its context, and what happened next.
included.description: A target is an upside or downside NQ price level identified when the service's qualifying conditions are met. Your subscription brings those observations and their recorded outcomes together in a dashboard and reports.
included.qualification: Targets are published only when predefined conditions qualify. A session may produce no targets.

artifacts.title: During the session
artifacts.description: Qualifying NQ targets are published with direction, timestamp, and session context through approved delivery channels.

artifacts.title: After the session
artifacts.description: Every target is retained with its recorded outcome and included in the completed-session email report.

artifacts.title: Over time
artifacts.description: Weekly summaries and historical views help your team evaluate behavior across completed sessions.

problem.title: A price target alone does not tell the whole story.
problem.description: Before adding research to your desk's workflow, you need to inspect its context and what followed. Scattered messages and isolated results make that review harder. Harper Vance keeps its published targets and recorded outcomes together.
problem.belief: Give your team a shared record to review before deciding whether the research fits.
items: Reached and unreached outcomes stay visible
Daily and weekly records follow the same format

operations.title: Bring clear questions to your research review.
operations.description: Authorized users can review current targets, completed-session analysis, weekly summaries, and historical behavior without changing the desk's execution workflow.
operations.delivery: Secure dashboard and email delivery are included. Desk Intelligence and Firm-Wide Enterprise also provide approved read-only API and webhook access within their license limits.
operations.integrity: Partial periods, small samples, unresolved targets, and unavailable aggregates remain visible so teams can interpret the record with its limitations intact.
operations.boundary: Built for review and governance, not order entry or execution.

items.title: Today's Targets
items.description: What has been published this session? Review target prices, direction, source timestamps, and the latest recorded status.

items.title: Daily Performance Record
items.description: What happened after each target? Review the session log, replay, outcome timing, and price movement away from the target.

items.title: Weekly Summary
items.description: How did observations vary across the week? Compare daily outcomes and timing, with sample sizes and incomplete periods visible.

items.title: Historical & Rolling
items.description: Does the behavior look consistent across sessions? Compare directional observations and day-by-day records within your licensed history.

evidence.title: See the record, then decide if it fits your desk.
evidence.description: Start with the format below. Request a completed-session report to inspect actual observations, then review the people, history, and delivery your desk needs. No trading result or return is promised.
